sourceDetails.caveats:
The default port is 1688

To configure vlmcsd, edit
  $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/etc/vlmcsd/vlmcsd.ini
After changing the configuration, please restart vlmcsd
  launchctl unload $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/vlmcsd/homebrew.mxcl.vlmcsd.plist
  launchctl load $HOMEBREW_PREFIX/opt/vlmcsd/homebrew.mxcl.vlmcsd.plist
Or, if you don't want/need launchctl, you can just run:
  brew services restart vlmcsd
